title: MOSS Image ranks 4th for pictures, before Klein 9B
description: Fabio 2026-10-29: MOSS is quite good; image order becomes Krea 2, Qwen-Image 2.1, FLUX.3 Klein, MOSS, Klein 9B, then the rest. Proven with a scratch agent-test run of Cosmo picking an installed model with Krea 2 missing (follow-up to MPI-1332).
